job.meaning: девушка ~23, техноблогер: объёмные тёмные кудри, яркие стрелки, рубашка колор-блок горчичный/зелёный, крупные серьги-кольца; фон — двухцветный зелёный/горчичный; яркая модная рекламная фотосессия в палитре «Свежий рынок», харизматичный и красивый человек; по пояс, по центру, лицо нейтральное, губы приоткрыты, без улыбки; без надписей
job.prompt: High-end fashion-editorial / advertising campaign photograph, vertical 9:16, waist-up, the person in the centre facing the camera, shoulders square, hands out of frame. The person is strikingly attractive, charismatic, stylish, with a memorable look — like the face of a trendy lifestyle brand campaign, NOT a stock photo. Expression: confident and alive but NEUTRAL, like in the middle of a sentence: lips slightly parted with a hint of teeth, NO smile, eyes straight into the lens with a spark. Headroom: top of the head about 16% of the frame height below the upper edge; the face is large and razor-sharp. Colour world from the attached board «Свежий рынок» (palette only, do NOT copy the man on it): leaf green #23A455, tomato red #FF4B2E, mustard yellow #FFC531, cream #FFF6E9. Bright, saturated, glossy commercial lighting: a soft beauty key light on the face plus a coloured rim/background light; vivid but flattering skin tones, natural skin texture. No text, no logos, no brand names, no badges, no headphones, no hats or sunglasses covering the face. A young woman of about 23, Slavic features, big voluminous dark curly hair, graphic winged eyeliner, wearing a bold colour-block shirt in mustard yellow and leaf green, chunky gold hoop earrings. Background: a seamless backdrop split diagonally into leaf green #23A455 and mustard #FFC531.
